headline: The heart can break now — HOMEBODY learns to fight
lede: Session 240 shipped Spats & Make-ups to Homebody: leave both residents miserable and within earshot and the household bond finally falls — demotions, grudges, cold war and the one way back. The sim's relationships went from a one-way ladder to a real one.

notes.text: A spat docks eight points off the household heart (a level demotion now visibly drops a pip and chimes a fall), stings both residents' social, and leaves a grudge: while it holds, sharing a room builds nothing. Tempers back up, same room — the pair makes up, +6 back, one contentment banked. 24 new node gates + 4 live-Chrome gates; the mutant that neuters the law dies on exactly those.

Triggers consume no rng, so every seed replays identically — determinism gates stayed green untouched. Panel tells scan as pixel-deltas (calm→hurt→healed) because the resident name-dot shares the heart's ember rgb; absolutes would have lied.

Board-derived never-dry pick needs honest shapes: GitHub returns issue labels as objects while the idle-ladder libs match label strings — object-shaped labels silently freed QA-held games from heldDirs. Flatten at the fetch, and treat an impossible result as the clue, not noise.

Exact-value asserts in live drives must stop the clock the tick the event lands (the ordinary climb resumes right after), and a 40-second sim window spans hour boundaries — refresh needs per tick or the test pair starves into a faint mid-quarrel-window.
